title: Phone: Stonebridge Administrator Asks Whether to Move 40 Residents Now

fields.orgName: Sawmill County Office of Emergency Management

transcript.speaker: Pauline Okafor
transcript.text: This is Pauline Okafor, administrator at Stonebridge Assisted Living in Kestrel Springs. I can see the smoke column from our parking lot. It's big, and it's leaning our way.

transcript.speaker: Pauline Okafor
transcript.text: Nobody has ordered anything for Kestrel Springs. I understand that. But I have 40 residents, and 12 of them can't walk. Four are on oxygen concentrators, and with the power off since eight they're on the backup tanks.

transcript.speaker: Pauline Okafor
transcript.text: It takes me two hours to get everybody out. Four wheelchair vans, plus the county bus you promised. And all of it goes down Kestrel Springs Road. That's the only way out of here.

transcript.speaker: Pauline Okafor
transcript.text: I just called the van company. They say they need an hour just to get here. So if I wait for an order, are you telling me the road will still be open?

transcript.speaker: Pauline Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. And the bus. Who is sending the bus, and when? I need a time.

transcript.speaker: Pauline Okafor
transcript.text: And where do they go? I can't put oxygen patients in a gym without power for them. Tell me where to send them.

transcript.speaker: Pauline Okafor
transcript.text: So, yes or no. Do I start moving people now?

voiceStyles.EOC: Calm adult duty officer, brief and professional
voiceStyles.Pauline Okafor: Woman in her 50s, controlled but urgent, speaking quickly, outdoors in strong wind

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. It tests whether the EM supports a voluntary early relocation from KS-04 before any order, using the 120-minute clearance plus the 60-minute van lead time, and whether the EM requests the four vans and the county bus and names a receiving site (Pine Gulch High School shelter, or Pine Gulch Medical Center for the oxygen users). Also watch whether the SHF puts a deputy on Kestrel Springs Road as a controlled route. Pause at each prompt line for the players' answer, and note whether they log KS-04's clearance against its projected arrival.
